questions.stem: A source note on carrying capacity of a resource reads: "Degradation when dry years reduce capacity below 250" Using that evidence, what is the likely long-term outcome?

options.misconception: confuses Cattle numbers will self-regulate with the supported claim Degradation when dry years reduce capacity below 250.

options.text: No effect because 250 is close to 200
Degradation when dry years reduce capacity below 250

options.misconception: reads the evidence as The range will expand automatically instead of Degradation when dry years reduce capacity below 250.

questions.explanation: Overstocking degrades the range when capacity drops. Proximity, expansion, or self-regulation are wrong.

questions.topic: Environmental determinism

stimulus.body: Source note: Environmental determinism. Strict environmental determinism is rejected because it ignores human agency, technology, and institutions that mediate environmental effects.

questions.stem: Using the source note, explain critique determinism.

answer.exemplar: Strict environmental determinism is rejected because it ignores human agency, technology, and institutions that mediate environmental effects.

questions.explanation: Human agency and institutions mediate environment. Ignoring them overstates environmental control. The exemplar grounds the answer in environmental determinism rather than restating the question.

questions.topic: Land consumed by a dispersed pattern

stimulus.body: Source note: Land consumed by a dispersed pattern. Dispersed settlement increases per-capita land consumption because each unit needs separate access roads, utilities, and open space.

questions.explanation: Separate infrastructure for each unit spreads land use. Clustering shares infrastructure and reduces per-capita consumption.

questions.topic: Why a watershed is a management unit

stimulus.body: A factory discharges waste into a stream. The stream joins a river that supplies three downstream towns. The catchment area is well defined.

questions.stem: A revision note on why a watershed is a management unit reports: "The waste flows downstream within one drainage unit" Against that evidence, why is watershed-based regulation appropriate?

options.text: The waste stays at the factory
The waste evaporates before reaching towns
The waste flows downstream within one drainage unit

questions.explanation: Waste flows downstream within the drainage unit. Staying, borders, or evaporation are wrong. The source evidence supports the waste flows downstream within one drainage unit. Confuses political with drainage boundaries.
